d:
Mokama se bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ke shadi ka charcha desh sahit videshon men bhi hai. panch bar ke vidhayak rahe anant sinh bahubal aur maphiya ke rup men jane jate hain lekin anant sinh ne apni beti shashivangi ki parhaee par kitna dhyan diya, aaie is par bhi najar dalte hai...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
